scope: Readable SQLite tables and JSON assets physically present in the supplied base.apk

exports.schema:
CREATE TABLE general_books (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    language TEXT NOT NULL,
    book_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    book_name_en TEXT,
    writer TEXT,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL,
    chapters_count INTEGER,
    sections_count INTEGER,
    pages_count INTEGER,
    UNIQUE(language, slug))

CREATE TABLE countries (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        iso TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        name TEXT NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE locations (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        country_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES countries(id),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        admin_area TEXT,
        latitude REAL NOT NULL,
        longitude REAL NOT NULL,
        timezone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES timezones(id),
        x REAL NOT NULL,
        y REAL NOT NULL,
        z REAL NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(country_id, ordinal)
      )

CREATE TABLE timezones (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
      )
